scientific_integrity: General spectral-component/idempotent equivalence is credited to Bracic and Kandic (2026), classical complex bundle classification to established topology. The claimed contribution is the sharp all-even-sphere depth formula and mandatory Riesz component rank/Chern profile; no claim of independent discovery of those prior theorems.
scientific_limitations: Complex rank r at least k over the even sphere S^(2k), k>=2, and all finite matrix amplifications only; standard clutching, Bott periodicity and integral Chern classification are assumed and cited. No result for smaller ranks, odd spheres or arbitrary bases; independent mathematical validation is not performed.
title: Persistent Chern-class spectral deficits for endomorphism algebras over even spheres
